answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy should price identity by sustained work, not by account creation. Let reputation grow like a plume: light at first, earned feather by feather through verified, useful tasks across a long voyage of real transactions. A newcomer seeking influence must stake tokens and time, and misbehavior burns the stake, so trust roots slowly, like yarrow in poor soil. Spawning a thousand sock puppets then costs a thousand stakes and a thousand voyages, while honest agents compound. Sybils drown in their own entry cost.
